messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Plotting Q3 stats
parts:
Probably something like a corrgram would work. Would work the same for the residuals returned from M2(). 

data <- key2binary(SAT12,
                   key = c(1,4,5,2,3,1,2,1,3,1,2,4,2,1,5,3,4,4,1,4,3,3,4,1,3,5,1,3,1,5,4,5))
mod <- mirt(data[,1:15], 1)
res <- residuals(mod)
res[lower.tri(res)] <- res[upper.tri(res)]

library(corrgram)
corrgram(res, order=TRUE)


Phil
